Definition: Zimmah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Zimmah is a Gershonite Levite, named in the genealogies and again in Hezekiah's cleansing of the temple, where Joah the son of Zimmah helps carry the filth out of the house of God. Whether the Zimmah of the lists is one man or two, the name runs through the Levites who served the sanctuary. Their full stories live on their People profiles.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the temple cleansers deserve remembering: when Hezekiah reopened the house, it was Levites like Zimmah's sons who did the carrying.
RelatedPeople: Zimmah, Son of Jahath; Zimmah, Father of Joah
